behind-crab-game._note: The game's view: behind-crab.json (the third-person camera 352 mm behind and 196 mm above a crab off the board's near-left corner, looking at the centre) with the red crab there, facing the centre, a tile in its right claw (drawn at half size while held). This frame goes under the HUD mock-ups. A copy of behind-crab.json plus the crab and its tile, written by a one-off script; regenerate it from behind-crab.json when that changes.
behind-crab-game.name: Behind a crab, in game

behind-crab-two._note: hud-base's game frame with a tile in each claw (the hold move): an R in the left claw and an E in the right (a grabbed tile is always held face up), at half size, tipped up toward the camera and set out sideways (look.json held), to check both read. Written by a one-off script from hud-base.json; regenerate it when that changes.
behind-crab-two.name: Behind a crab, two tiles

behind-crab._note: Where the third-person camera stands for a crab starting off the board's near-left corner (-1752, 0, 1752): 352 mm behind it and 196 mm up (the crab has a 90 mm shell, R1.8), looking toward the board's centre. No crab is in it yet: the crab is added later; this frame goes under the HUD mock-ups. Written by tools/piles.py (seed 1); regenerate rather than edit. Square (row r, column c), both 0 to 14, is at x = (c - 7) * 210, z = (r - 7) * 210; the board's top is y = 40.
behind-crab.name: Behind a crab

board-above._note: The board straight from above, filling the frame: every premium square's colour and label, and the centre star. Written by tools/piles.py (seed 1); regenerate rather than edit. crab-colours._note: The one crab in the four seat colours side by side (red, yellow, blue, purple), idling at different moments: the shell takes the seat colour, the underside, legs and claw tips its lighter and darker shades.

crab-corner._note: A red crab just off the board's near-left corner (-1645, 0, 1645), where a crab starts, facing the centre, a tile in its right claw. crab-grab-left._note: The grab_left move as a strip (scripts/shot.py --grid ms=...): the claw reaches forward and down, opens, closes on the tile's near edge and lifts; the see-through tile marks where the tile lay on the sand.

crab-grab-right._note: The grab_right move as a strip (scripts/shot.py --grid ms=...): the claw reaches forward and down, opens, closes on the tile's near edge and lifts; the see-through tile marks where the tile lay on the sand.
